template.name: Futures Engulfing Candle Size
template.entry_long: close > open and high - low > atr(high,low,close,{p0})
template.exit_long: close < open and high - low > atr(high,low,close,{p1})
template.notes: The 25-tick candle-range threshold is replaced by a range larger than ATR(14) (14 is a fallback, no ATR period is documented) with direction from the candle body, as documented. The 07:00-09:15 session window and the 50/40 tick take-profit and stop-loss are tick or time based and are not percent fields.
